286.sourceName: Hidden Stash from creatures in Eastern Plaguelands
286.instructions: Unlock Fiona's Caravan buffs, choose Fiona's Lucky Charm, then loot creatures in Eastern Plaguelands for Hidden Stash. The pet is a chance reward from the stash. Reapply the buff after leaving the zone.

4945.instructions: The journal associates this species with Re-Hydra-ted, but that association has not been verified as an obtainable reward. No confirmed source NPC or map destination is available for this species.

2077.instructions: Visit the rotating Fisherfriend when she is active and exchange 50 Fragmented Enchantments. The fishing buff requires remaining near the active NPC.

1449.instructions: Join a guild that already earned Challenge Warlords: Gold - Guild Edition and reach the required guild reputation. The historical guild achievement cannot be newly earned, but an already-qualified guild can still sell the pet.
Requires a guild with the historical Challenge Warlords: Gold - Guild Edition unlock and sufficient guild reputation.

3524.instructions: Complete Researchers Under Fire in Zaralek Cavern and open the event reward cache for a chance at the pet. The event is in the central ruins; its icon marks the current start location.

3545.instructions: Use Sniffenseeking with Myrrit in Loamm to obtain an Ouroboros Tablet, then loot Kob'rok's Luminescent Scale from Kob'rok. Combine the tablet with the scale to create Salverun. The two points mark Myrrit and the rare.

3581.instructions: Collect all sixteen motes across the Dragon Isles, including the Forbidden Reach. They can be collected in any order. Each pin is an actual mote location; some are on towers, trees or high peaks.

4636.instructions: In Undermine, unlock the G-99 Breakneck and use its job interface to complete Shipping and Handling streaks. Renown 8 unlocks Expert Haggler rewards; complete nine consecutive jobs for a chance at cosmetic rewards. There is no stationary pet drop NPC.

4755.instructions: The old journal labels this as a Gallagio Garbage drop during S.C.R.A.P. jobs in Undermine, but the species is hidden and a working acquisition source remains unverified. This map shows the associated area, not a confirmed farmable pet spawn.

2795.instructions: Complete the secret starting with Amara Lunastar, then the Empty Dish and the Return to Karazhan food puzzle.

1699.sourceName: Legion Enchanting - Tigrid the Charmer's formula
1699.instructions: Learn Legion Enchanting and follow Enchanter Nalthanis's profession quests in Broken Isles Dalaran (38.3, 40.3) until An Enchanting Home. Visit Tigrid the Charmer in Stormheim (39.4, 42.6), complete A Touch of Magic, then Halls of Valor: Revenge of the Enchantress. Recover her rod in Halls of Valor and return it to unlock her shop. Buy Formula: Enchanted Cauldron for 50 Arkhana, learn it and craft the pet. Alternatively, buy the crafted pet or a caged copy from another player or the Auction House.

1700.sourceName: Legion Enchanting - Tigrid the Charmer's formula
1700.instructions: Learn Legion Enchanting and follow Enchanter Nalthanis's profession quests in Broken Isles Dalaran (38.3, 40.3) until An Enchanting Home. Visit Tigrid the Charmer in Stormheim (39.4, 42.6), complete A Touch of Magic, then Halls of Valor: Revenge of the Enchantress. Recover her rod in Halls of Valor and return it to unlock her shop. Buy Formula: Enchanted Torch for 50 Arkhana, learn it and craft the pet. Alternatively, buy the crafted pet or a caged copy from another player or the Auction House.

1701.sourceName: Legion Enchanting - Halls of Valor: Revenge of the Enchantress
1701.instructions: Learn Legion Enchanting and progress Enchanter Nalthanis's profession story in Broken Isles Dalaran (38.3, 40.3) until An Enchanting Home. Visit Tigrid the Charmer in Stormheim (39.4, 42.6), complete A Touch of Magic, and accept Halls of Valor: Revenge of the Enchantress. Recover Tigrid's Enchanting Rod in Halls of Valor and return it to her to learn Enchanted Pen. Craft the pet with the learned recipe, or buy a crafted/caged copy on the Auction House. The map follows the first unfinished prerequisite; the quest rewards the recipe, not the finished pet.

1756.sourceName: Legion Alchemy - Transmute: Meat to Pet / Growling Sac
1756.instructions: Learn Legion Alchemy from Deucus Valdera in Broken Isles Dalaran (41.3, 33.4). Complete the alchemy-station quest chain through Return the Filter, then buy Recipe: Wild Transmutation from Patricia Egan in the same shop (42.2, 32.3). Perform Wild Transmutation at the Dalaran Alchemy Station each day until you discover Transmute: Meat to Pet. Use that recipe to make a Pulsating Sac and wait 7 real-time days for it to become a Growling Sac. Open it for a random pet; Ridgeback Piglet is one possible result. Repeat if needed, or buy a caged Ridgeback Piglet on the Auction House.
1756.locationType: Wild Transmutation recipe / Dalaran Alchemy Station

1759.sourceName: Legion Alchemy - Transmute: Meat to Pet / Growling Sac
1759.instructions: Learn Legion Alchemy from Deucus Valdera in Broken Isles Dalaran (41.3, 33.4). Perform Wild Transmutation at the Dalaran Alchemy Station each day until you discover Transmute: Meat to Pet. Use that recipe to make a Pulsating Sac and wait 7 real-time days for it to become a Growling Sac. Open it for a random pet; Thaumaturgical Piglet is one possible result. Repeat if needed, or buy a caged Thaumaturgical Piglet on the Auction House.
1759.locationType: Wild Transmutation recipe / Dalaran Alchemy Station

1920.sourceName: Legion Alchemy - Transmute: Meat to Pet / Growling Sac
1920.instructions: Learn Legion Alchemy from Deucus Valdera in Broken Isles Dalaran (41.3, 33.4). Use that recipe to make a Pulsating Sac and wait 7 real-time days for it to become a Growling Sac. Open it for a random pet; Transmutant is one possible result. Repeat if needed, or buy a caged Transmutant on the Auction House.
1920.locationType: Wild Transmutation recipe / Dalaran Alchemy Station

1886.sourceName: Legion Engineering - Halls of Valor: Trigger Happy
1886.instructions: Learn Legion Engineering in Broken Isles Dalaran and follow the engineering story until Hobart Grapplehammer offers Halls of Valor: Trigger Happy. Accept it at the engineering shop (38.4, 24.7), defeat Odyn in Halls of Valor and loot the Runestone of Vitality. Return to Hobart to learn Trigger. Craft it at Legion Engineering 90 with 50 Leystone Ore, 30 Loose Trigger, 20 Oversized Blasting Cap, 2 Sniping Scope, 50 Blood of Sargeras and 10 Infernal Brimstone. You can instead buy a caged Trigger from another player or the Auction House without Engineering.

1806.sourceName: Blingtron 6000 Gift Package - portable daily gift / Reaves engineering unlock
1806.instructions: Accept Blingtron 6000's daily gift quest and open the Blingtron 6000 Gift Package for a chance at Knockoff Blingtron. Another player's Blingtron works; it is portable and has no permanent spawn. To summon your own, progress Legion Engineering with Didi the Wrench in Broken Isles Dalaran (38.6, 25.0), complete Short Circuit and Oil Rags to Riches, craft Reaves Module: Bling Mode and install it on Reaves. Summon Reaves with a battery and choose Bling Mode. The marker follows this engineering unlock route, not a fixed Blingtron spawn. Alternatively, buy a caged pet on the Auction House.
1806.locationType: Optional engineering unlock for your own portable Blingtron

2117.sourceName: Legion Herbalism - herb nodes on Argus
2117.instructions: Learn Legion Herbalism, unlock Argus through The Hand of Fate and follow the Argus campaign to open its zones. Gather herbs in Krokuun, Antoran Wastes or Eredath: Fel-Encrusted Herb nodes and Astral Glory can yield Fel Lasher. Keep gathering; this is a rare bonus from harvesting herbs, not a wild pet you trap or a stationary creature drop. The map opens the actual gathering zones because herb nodes move and respawn. You can also buy a caged Fel Lasher from another player or the Auction House.

2121.sourceName: Legion Skinning - skinnable creatures on Argus
2121.instructions: Learn Legion Skinning and unlock Argus through The Hand of Fate. Kill and skin beasts on Argus for a rare chance at Fossorial Bile Larva; the pet comes from skinning, not their normal loot or pet battles. One reported farm is Chitinbuk Ruinwalkers in Eredath around 52.0, 35.0. Panthara in Krokuun's Petrified Forest and other skinnable Argus beasts are alternatives. Keep skinning until the pet drops, or buy a caged copy on the Auction House. The marker is a farming area, not a guaranteed pet spawn; Fiendish Leather ranks improve material yield but a particular rank is not established as a pet requirement.
2121.locationType: Chitinbuk skinning farm - rare bonus, not a pet spawn

36862.instructions: Use Pick Pocket on Northrend humanoids; this is a rare pickpocket reward. The map choices identify farming regions, not guaranteed drops.

36863.instructions: Use Pick Pocket on Northrend humanoids; this is a rare pickpocket reward. The map choices identify farming regions, not guaranteed drops.

37254.instructions: A rare Northrend world drop. There is no single guaranteed rare or fixed spawn to mark. The map choices identify farming regions, not guaranteed drops.

63269.instructions: Use Pick Pocket on Cataclysm-zone humanoids. The areas show potential farming regions; there is no single fixed source NPC.

187419.instructions: Pick up eligible Kyrian Callings in the covenant sanctum, complete them, and open Tribute of the Ascended / Tribute of the Paragon. This toy is a chance reward from those caches, not a vendor purchase.

187512.instructions: Pick up eligible Venthyr Callings in the covenant sanctum, complete them, and open Tribute of the Court / Favor of the Court. This toy is a chance reward from those caches, not a vendor purchase.

187840.instructions: Pick up eligible Night Fae Callings in the covenant sanctum, complete them, and open Bounty of the Grove Wardens / Tribute of the Wild Hunt. This toy is a chance reward from those caches, not a vendor purchase.

187913.instructions: Pick up eligible Necrolord Callings in the covenant sanctum, complete them, and open Tribute of the Ambitious / Tribute of the Duty-Bound. This toy is a chance reward from those caches, not a vendor purchase.

231064.sourceName: Sir Finley Mrrgglton: retired Delves Season 2 reward
231064.instructions: This was sold at Delver's Headquarters during The War Within Season 2. It was removed in 11.2 and was not transferred to the legacy Reno Jackson inventory; the marker is historical context.

availability.reason: Delves Season 2 reward removed in patch 11.2; no active legacy purchase.

170197.instructions: Purchase for 500 Plunder in the Plunderstore when Plunderstorm is available. This uses the event shop interface, not a fixed NPC in the normal world.

200148.instructions: A chance reward associated with Dragon Isles rares. These are recorded Thaldraszus rare-enemy locations; access and spawns may depend on quests or phase conditions.

190754.instructions: This is a chance reward from Firim's eligible rotating quests, including Materials of Creation, Forcing the Cycle and Portal Play. Repeat eligible quests when offered; a previous completion does not guarantee the toy.

173951.sourceName: Automatically offered War Mode PvP quest
173951.instructions: Enable War Mode in a Battle for Azeroth zone, become an Assassin by defeating opposing-faction players without dying, then accept the automatically offered Servant of N'Zoth quest. Complete its same-faction kills without dying. There is no fixed quest-giver NPC.

132518.instructions: Progress the Legion Engineering story with Didi the Wrench in Broken Isles Dalaran (38.6, 25.0) until Short Circuit. Follow its investigation: Rocket-Chief Fuselage in Area 52, Ricket in K3, Chief Engineer Foote in Ratchet, Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan, then Winkey in eastern Tanaris. Borrow Winkey's Diving Helmet and find Gnopetto's underwater workshop and journal off Tanaris. This teaches Blingtron's Circuit Design Tutorial. Craft the toy with 50 Leystone Ore, 50 Felslate and 5 Infernal Brimstone, then use it to add it to the Toy Box. Alternatively, buy the finished toy on the Auction House; using it does not require Engineering.

130254.instructions: Begin Legion Jewelcrafting with Tiffany Cartier in Broken Isles Dalaran (39.9, 34.8) and follow her profession story through Come at Me, Brul and The Charge Within. Jabrul in Stormheim (42.2, 35.0) offers Mysteries of Nature: collect Dragon Glass from the mountainside at 46.7, 31.3 and return it to learn Chatterstone. Craft it with 10 Sangrite, 10 Chaotic Spinel and 1 Blood of Sargeras, then use it to collect the toy. You can also buy the finished toy from another player or the Auction House without Jewelcrafting.

130251.instructions: Follow Tiffany Cartier's Legion Jewelcrafting story through To Dalaran, With Love, then inspect the toy box in the Dalaran jewelry shop (40.0, 35.3) to accept Socket to Me. Collect Crystal Shell from the Truesilver Crab in the Northern Stranglethorn wreck (35.7, 55.9), Crystal Core in Deepholm (51.9, 20.7), Crystal Scale in Twilight Highlands (26.0, 69.7), Crystal Heart from the Golden Hare in Vale of Eternal Blossoms (14.2, 67.2), Crystal Plume in Moonglade (31.0, 47.7), and Crystal Shard inside Highmountain's Greystone Enclave (entrance 54.5, 75.4). Return the components to learn JewelCraft, craft the toy and use it. Buying the finished toy on the Auction House skips the profession chain.
130251.locationType: Toy box - Socket to Me quest start

129961.sourceName: Legion Leatherworking - Pattern: Flaming Hoop / Laura Malley
129961.instructions: Learn Legion Leatherworking, then buy Pattern: Flaming Hoop from Laura Malley in the Broken Isles Dalaran Underbelly (58.0, 58.1) for 100 Sightless Eyes. Earn the currency from Underbelly activities and rare creatures; check whether the sewer guards are present before entering its PvP areas. Learn the pattern, craft Flaming Hoop and use the finished item to add it to the Toy Box. The marker is Laura's recipe shop, not a direct toy purchase. Alternatively, buy the finished toy on the Auction House; Leatherworking is not needed to use it.

129958.sourceName: Legion Leatherworking - Pattern: Leather Pet Leash / Laura Malley
129958.instructions: Learn Legion Leatherworking, then buy Pattern: Leather Pet Leash from Laura Malley in the Broken Isles Dalaran Underbelly (58.0, 58.1) for 50 Sightless Eyes. Earn the currency from Underbelly activities and rare creatures; check whether the sewer guards are present before entering its PvP areas. Learn the pattern, craft Leather Pet Leash and use the finished item to add it to the Toy Box. The marker is Laura's recipe shop, not a direct toy purchase. Alternatively, buy the finished toy on the Auction House; Leatherworking is not needed to use it.

129956.sourceName: Legion Leatherworking - Pattern: Leather Love Seat / Xur'ios
129956.instructions: Visit Xur'ios beside the bank in Broken Isles Dalaran (48.8, 13.5) and check his rotating stock for Pattern: Leather Love Seat, priced at 1 Curious Coin. Return on another day if the pattern is absent. Curious Coins are rare rewards from Broken Isles treasures, rare creatures and other Legion reward containers. Learn the pattern with Legion Leatherworking, craft Leather Love Seat and use the finished toy. You can instead buy the finished toy from another player or the Auction House without Leatherworking.
129956.locationType: Rotating Leather Love Seat pattern vendor

129960.instructions: Begin Legion Leatherworking with Namha Moonwater in Broken Isles Dalaran (35.4, 29.6), starting with Skin Deep. Follow her story through Dazed of the Past and Battle Bonds, then accept Playthings. Collect the tanning mixture from the red bottle on the workbench behind Namha. Use the quest workbench recipes in order: 8 Shaved Stonehide Pelts, 8 Tanned Stonehide Leather, 2 Stonehide Leather Linings, 5 Stonehide Leather Strips, then the prototype Stonehide Leather Bed. Turn it in to learn Leather Pet Bed, craft the collectible with 50 Stonehide Leather and 5 Felhide, and use it. Alternatively, buy the finished toy on the Auction House.
129960.locationType: Leather Pet Bed recipe quest / Namha's Workbench

128536.sourceName: Legion Enchanting - Formula: Leylight Brazier / K'huta
128536.instructions: Buy Formula: Leylight Brazier from K'huta in the Broken Isles Dalaran Underbelly (66.0, 79.9) for 250 Sightless Eyes. Gather the currency from Underbelly activities and rare creatures. Learn the formula with Legion Enchanting, then craft Leylight Brazier with 1 Chaos Crystal, 100 Arkhana and 5 Blood of Sargeras. Use the finished item to add it to the Toy Box. The marker identifies the formula vendor. You can instead buy the finished toy from another player or the Auction House without Enchanting.

129211.sourceName: Legion Inscription - The Legacy Passed On / Bill Spearshaker
129211.instructions: Learn Legion Inscription from Professor Pallin in Broken Isles Dalaran (41.3, 37.0) and progress the profession story until An Embarrassing Revelation. Bring him the Steamy Romance Novel and accept The Plot Thickens. Find Bill Spearshaker in Ironforge (77.2, 10.4) and complete The Legacy Passed On by interacting with the unfinished book and choosing a complete story. This teaches Steamy Romance Novel Kit; craft the toy and use it to collect it. The finished toy is tradable, so buying it on the Auction House skips Inscription and its quest chain.
129211.locationType: Steamy Romance Novel Kit recipe quest

129211.sourceName: Legion Inscription - The Legacy Passed On / Ferdinand Serbacon
129211.instructions: Learn Legion Inscription from Professor Pallin in Broken Isles Dalaran (41.3, 37.0) and progress the profession story until An Embarrassing Revelation. Bring him the Steamy Romance Novel and accept The Plot Thickens. Find Ferdinand Serbacon in Undercity (77.8, 38.8) and complete The Legacy Passed On by interacting with the unfinished book and choosing a complete story. This teaches Steamy Romance Novel Kit; craft the toy and use it to collect it. If Undercity is in its destroyed phase, ask Zidormi in Tirisfal Glades to show the city before the Battle for Lordaeron. The finished toy is tradable, so buying it on the Auction House skips Inscription and its quest chain.
129211.locationType: Steamy Romance Novel Kit recipe quest

legion_legacy_brutal_gladiator_arsenal.sourceName: Blaze Magmaburn - Brutal Gladiator weapon arsenal
legion_legacy_brutal_gladiator_arsenal.instructions: Collect 80 Marks of Honor from PvP reward containers, then visit Blaze Magmaburn in Area 52, Netherstorm (33.2, 64). Buy the Brutal Gladiator weapon arsenal for 80 Marks of Honor and use the purchased wrapper to add its appearances to your collection. The arsenal teaches the season's weapon appearances, including weapon types your current character cannot equip. Buying only individual weapons can cost fewer marks if you want a small subset. The vendor is inside the PvP-vendor building in Area 52 in Outland.

Buy the Cataclysmic Gladiator weapon arsenal for 80 Marks of Honor and use the purchased wrapper to add its appearances to your collection. The arsenal teaches the season's weapon appearances, including weapon types your current character cannot equip. Buying only individual weapons can cost fewer marks if you want a small subset. 58076.name: Speak with Amara Lunastar
58076.instructions: Speak with Amara Lunastar in Ashenvale about her missing cat.

58098.name: Inspect the Empty Dish
58098.instructions: Inspect the Empty Dish inside the cat house in Elwynn Forest.

58099.name: Solve the Jenafur food puzzle
58099.instructions: Enter Return to Karazhan, clear the required rooms, then place the food in the Opera Hall in the Amara's Wish pattern. Pet Jenafur when she appears. The marker is the dungeon entrance.

46952.name: Bring Dog a Loose Pebble

variants.name: Bring Dog a Loose Pebble
variants.instructions: Find a Loose Pebble in Legion Dalaran and show it to Dog in your garrison Herb Garden. Do not throw the pebble.

variants.name: Bring Dog a Loose Pebble
variants.instructions: Find a Loose Pebble in Legion Dalaran and show it to Dog in your garrison Herb Garden. Do not throw the pebble.

46952.instructions: Find a Loose Pebble in Legion Dalaran, build the garrison Herb Garden, and show the pebble to Dog. Do not throw it.

83093.name: Inspect the Half-Buried Dog Bowl
83093.instructions: Interact with the Half-Buried Dog Bowl near Dalaran's crash site on the Isle of Dorn.

83094.name: Pet Dog
83094.instructions: Interact with Dog and choose to pet his head to learn Faithful Dog.

77303.name: Idol Searching
77303.instructions: Speak with Tithris in the Roasted Ram. Bring the Torch of Pyrreth and follow the brazier clues to Teerakai.

77304.name: An Idol in Hand
77304.instructions: After lighting the braziers with the Torch of Pyrreth, collect the idol by the last brazier at Teerakai and return it to Preservationist Kathos.
